entities.summary: Madabhushi Rangadorai, better known by his pen name Randor Guy, was an Indian lawyer, columnist and film and legal historian associated with the English language newspaper The Hindu. He was also the official editor of the weekly column "Blast from the Past" that appeared in The Hindu for many years; in this series Randor Guy wrote about not so well known details about the Tamil movies and the personalities, produced since the mid-1930s to late 1960s. Randor Guy was a legal figures from Nellore (1937-11-08, Nellore–2023-04-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
